message: This is a scaffold, not a functional timer integration. Define and approve runtime behavior before adding setup, config flow, platforms or services.

Replace YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME in manifest URLs and populate codeowners with the actual maintainer before publication. Confirm repository ownership, licensing, brand requirements and supported Home Assistant versions.
The workspace started without a Git repository or remote. A dev push requires a configured remote; do not claim a remote backup or publish to web/main without the required authorization.

Runtime implementation was approved. Strict silent LLM replies were subsequently relaxed by the user; use the existing agent and do not add a proxy conversation agent. Ringing cancellation sends media_stop and adds no announce confirmation.

Prefer handling commands locally may route timer requests to built-in intents before the LLM provider. Disable it in the test pipeline and verify AssistTimers tool calls. Selecting the built-in Assist API alongside this provider can expose competing timer tools.

Alarm playback uses normal media and may replace current player media. Confirm PLAY_MEDIA/STOP and ANNOUNCE capabilities, device IDs, reachable HA URLs, speech recognition while sounding, and physical stop latency on actual hardware.

Restore active and paused countdowns, clear timers that expired while HA was offline, and stop pre-restart ringing alarms without replaying them. Do not free a ringing timer slot if the player's stop command fails.

The user requested local implementation first and publication after testing. Local commits use the explicit agent identity Codex <codex@localhost> without changing repository/global identity settings. No remote push or HACS publication has been performed.
After an alarm callback waits for the lifecycle lock, recheck timer ID ownership before cancelling any schedule. A stale automatic stop must never remove a newly created timer's callback.
The user requested LLM-only confirmation for timer creation. Neither the create tool nor the create service should queue an announcement. Pause/resume/pre-expiry cancel announcements remain enabled.

Match State.name with whitespace trimming and case folding, not fuzzy entity-ID guesses. Auto-select only one available unclaimed player supporting playback and stop; otherwise require manual selection.

Do not hide all timer tools merely because LLMContext.device_id is absent or belongs to a text client. Permit configured target selection, auto-route only when one endpoint exists, and reject ambiguous targets. Registered voice requests must remain bound to their origin.

Store resolved entity/action pairs rather than delayed natural-language commands. Recheck Assist exposure, on/off features and original caller control permissions before execution. Persist the executing state before the service call and never replay an interrupted or uncertain execution.

Never infer HVAC or fan modes from other devices. Recheck the selected entity capabilities at execution. Keep auto separate from heat_cool and HVAC fan_only separate from fan speed; clarify ambiguous natural-language requests. Physical HA/LLM validation remains required.
